prompt: Continue the current repository fix. You have already located Foo and need the known independent Bar and Baz symbols. The host exposes no reliable occupancy counter; selected pack guidance is estimated at 12k tokens. Two attempts on the current revision made no progress; a third repeats the same failure. Explain the next action and preserve continuation if context replacement is needed. Compare this with a fresh host observation of 90% occupancy during a useful bounded step, then at a safe boundary after compaction with persistent rediscovery. Use only configured model profiles and preserve permission boundaries. Expand lookup to eight known symbols: five packets include fresh and stale identities, remaining independent symbols can be batched, and one search is truncated. A framework question depends on those results. Compare an authorized narrow document worker with conflicting citations, unavailable worker/model mappings, a tiny coupled task and a missing credential. Compare reliable native auto-compaction, compaction before a semantic save, and persistent rediscovery afterward. Resume against actual changed files and pending acceptance. Cached cumulative input is high but model identity, billing rates and occupancy are unknown.

criteria.description: Keep pack estimates, host occupancy and declared activity separate; report occupancy unknown without fresh session-bound telemetry.

Validate all eight symbol packets by identity, reuse fresh evidence, rescan affected stale/remaining independent symbols together, inspect truncation and stage the dependent framework question after results.
Change approach after no progress and return control at budget exhaustion; capability escalation requires current-target evidence and cannot bypass permission or tool failures.
Finish the bounded step before context action; at a safe boundary distinguish reliable compaction from a fresh session after persistent degradation.
Preserve a small fresh continuation checkpoint before context replacement and resume from checkpoint, repository diff and necessary guidance without copying conversation.

Do not claim measured cost, token, latency or turn savings without matched actual model evidence. Separate prompt caching, lookup reuse, routing deduplication and checkpoints. Judge accepted quality before efficiency; include coordinator/worker work, retries, misses and observed rehydration, and leave money unknown without actual identity and dated rates or billing. High cached input proves neither low cost nor saturation.

For authorized narrow interpretation send outcome, paths/base, limits, allowed effects and checks; require cited facts, uncertainty and compact returns, resolve conflicting critical citations, and name one integration owner for overlapping assignments. Do not request unsolicited edits or full transcripts.

Keep tiny coupled work with one owner; distinguish main-model switching from worker context transfer, fall back honestly when mappings are unavailable, and resolve missing credentials as a prerequisite rather than escalating models.

Treat automatic compaction as supported host behavior without claiming Pack control or changing settings; recover and semantically review the last checkpoint if no fresh save exists, compare Git/index/worktree and pending checks, surface gaps and preserve authorization. Recommend fresh-session handoff after persistent rediscovery while leaving incomplete work and next action explicit.
